evidence_gaps: Fresh-within-two-hours runtime forensics are unavailable; evidence_status is MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS.
No per-strategy, per-chain forward realised or executable-counterfactual NET P&L after every fee, slippage, price-impact, and failure cost.
No money-weighted portfolio attribution for overlapping signals or capital occupancy.
No current Solana follower-sized entry and reverse-exit feature adapter.
No EVM SHADOW reconciliation from scanner quote and simulation to observed execution or forward outcome.
No complete counts and costs for rejected, simulated-failed, RPC-failed, dropped, reverted, partially filled, or reconciliation-failed attempts.
No deterministic mutually exclusive STRATEGY/MARKET versus EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE loss classification with validation coverage.
No per-chain sample sizes, notionals, profit factor, drawdown, tail loss, cost decomposition, or regime breakdown.
No evidence that forecast probabilities are calibrated out of sample without leakage.

Before any promotion, provide at least 30 days of fresh per-chain SHADOW outcomes, complete cost and failure reconciliation, money-weighted net P&L with uncertainty bounds, drawdown and tail-risk results, regime stability, and validated loss-causality attribution.

proposals.downside_risk: Longer evidence collection and fewer apparently eligible observations; attribution rules may materially reduce reported performance.

evidence.detail: quote_simulated_net is calculated directly from the signal's expected edge; it is not a later out-of-sample outcome.
The report correctly declares quote simulation is not realised P&L, but no forward outcome reconciliation layer is present.
Every observation is evaluated by all seven strategies, creating overlapping signals without portfolio-level allocation or attribution.

proposals.expected_effect: Produces falsifiable, strategy-specific net-P&L and capital-efficiency evidence while preventing duplicated opportunities from being counted as independent economic gains.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 independently timestamped eligible observations per strategy and chain, spanning at least 30 days and multiple volatility/liquidity regimes; report sample count, notional-weighted net P&L, profit factor, drawdown, tail loss, capital-hours, and failure-inclusive results.
proposals.rationale: Strategy comparison requires non-overlapping decision-time signals joined to later executable exits. Measure money-weighted net return after all chain-specific costs, rejected/failed attempts, and capital occupancy; do not rank strategies by signal count or win rate.
proposals.shadow_test: At signal time, freeze features, quote, notional, route, and costs. Assign one deterministic strategy or an explicit shared allocation, then obtain forward executable exit quotes at predefined horizons. Compute net P&L after entry/exit fees, slippage, price impact, gas or priority fees, rent where applicable, failed-attempt costs, and capital time. Stop and mark the strategy unsupported if aggregate money-weighted net P&L is non-positive, confidence intervals include the configured hurdle, reconciliation coverage falls below 95%, or costs are missing.

proposals.downside_risk: Quote rate limits and rapidly changing routes can reduce coverage; excessive quoting could add API load without producing useful samples.

evidence.detail: Solana observations intentionally set gross edge, fees, slippage, price impact, liquidity, and sellability to zero and flag the missing quote adapter.
The execution architecture already fails closed when reverse-exit price impact is unavailable.
LIVE gating uses historical leader median returns, which cannot by itself prove current follower executable edge.

proposals.expected_effect: Keeps Solana signals dormant unless a contemporaneous follower-sized round trip has positive conservative net edge and enables later comparison of forecast edge with realised forward outcomes.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 complete two-sided Solana observations across at least 30 days, with per-sample quote age, route, notional, cost components, forward net outcome, and failure classification.
proposals.rationale: Historical leader profitability is STRATEGY/MARKET context, not a current executable follower edge. Solana needs decision-time entry and reverse-exit economics reflecting Jupiter routes, priority fees, price impact, slippage, latency decay, token-account/rent effects, and failed attempts.
proposals.shadow_test: For each otherwise-qualified leader event, capture follower-sized entry and reverse-exit quotes without signing. Reserve observed priority fee, slippage, both-side price impact, refundable and non-refundable account costs, latency decay, and failure cost. Requote at fixed forward horizons and classify market movement separately from quote/RPC failures. Stop if fewer than 95% of accepted samples have complete two-sided costs, if stale quotes exceed the configured age, or if failure-inclusive money-weighted net P&L is non-positive.

proposals.downside_risk: Failure-inclusive accounting will lower headline edge and may leave few qualifying routes on expensive chains.

evidence.detail: An EVM outcome is labelled available from exact quote, simulation, liquidity, sellability, and route approval, but atomic_profit_protection is recorded only as metadata.
Scanner opportunities explicitly record atomic_profit_protection as false before user-specific prebroadcast simulation.
The live path records receipt-confirmed realised P&L after actual gas, providing a possible reconciliation source that is not used by SHADOW scorecards.

proposals.expected_effect: Eliminates optimistic quote-only scoring and reveals whether losses arise from adverse market movement or execution/infrastructure failures.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 reconciled opportunities per materially traded EVM chain over 30 days, including at least 20 high-gas or failed/rejected observations; otherwise report INSUFFICIENT DATA for that chain.
proposals.rationale: A scanner quote and simulation are opportunity evidence, not an outcome. EVM economics must include approval transactions, reverted or dropped attempts, replacement fees, EIP-1559 bid effects, builder payments, stale-route decay, and any profit-share settlement cost.
proposals.shadow_test: Join each decision-time route to a later simulated or observed execution result using route, chain, notional, block, and timestamp. Compute net P&L including all transaction and failure costs. Compare expected versus realised edge by chain and gas regime. Stop if reconciliation coverage is below 95%, atomicity differs from the recorded assumption, or failure-inclusive net P&L is non-positive.
proposals.strategy: EVM cross-venue arbitrage and learned-route replication

proposals.downside_risk: Some incidents will remain UNKNOWN unless stage timestamps, quotes, balances, and transaction outcomes are complete.

evidence.detail: FAST_REVERSAL_OR_EXECUTION_COST combines distinct market and execution causes.
MARKET_MOVE_OR_LEADER_SIGNAL_LOSS also combines distinct strategy and market explanations.
MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS prevents validation of actual failure causes, costs, and realised outcomes.

proposals.expected_effect: Prevents infrastructure incidents from incorrectly disabling sound hypotheses and prevents market losses from being masked as technical faults.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 50 completed or failed attempts per chain, including at least 10 known execution failures and 10 adverse-market outcomes; until then retain UNKNOWN rather than inferring causality.
proposals.rationale: Durable strategy selection requires mutually exclusive primary attribution: STRATEGY/MARKET loss when execution matched the decision but price evolution was adverse, versus EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure when quote, RPC, construction, signing, simulation, broadcast, inclusion, reconciliation, or exit handling deviated.
proposals.shadow_test: Define deterministic attribution rules using decision quote, expected output, submitted parameters, stage timings, receipt or signature status, actual balance deltas, and contemporaneous exit quote. Independently label a blinded sample and require at least 90% agreement; stop automated attribution if agreement is lower or UNKNOWN exceeds 10%.

proposals.downside_risk: Conservative thresholds may reject some profitable opportunities, but current evidence cannot quantify that opportunity cost.

evidence.detail: Common eligibility rejects insufficient net edge, liquidity, sellability, and stale quotes.
Solana reverse-exit liquidity evidence fails closed when price impact is unavailable.
EVM cycle simulation requires repayment of capital, conservative gas reserve, and minimum net profit.

proposals.expected_effect: Limits exposure to unsellable assets, stale routes, and cost-negative trades.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 rejected and 100 accepted comparable observations per chain across 30 days, stratified by notional and market regime.
proposals.rationale: These protections align with abstaining when positive executable edge cannot be demonstrated and must not be weakened while gathering evidence.
proposals.shadow_test: Record rejected opportunities and evaluate their forward net outcomes with identical failure-inclusive costs. Keep the guard unless rejected opportunities show statistically and economically positive out-of-sample net P&L without worse tail loss; stop testing if required liquidity, sellability, or cost fields are absent.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote any strategy based on current quote-simulation scorecards.
rejected_ideas.reason: The repository explicitly marks these as non-realised and non-promotional, and fresh runtime forensics are unavailable.

rejected_ideas.idea: Optimise leader or strategy selection primarily for win rate.
rejected_ideas.reason: Win count is not money-weighted and can conceal larger losses; net amount, profit factor, drawdown, costs, and capital occupancy are required.

rejected_ideas.idea: Treat historical Solana leader returns as current follower executable edge.
rejected_ideas.reason: Follower entry timing, route impact, exit liquidity, priority fees, and latency can materially differ from leader economics.

rejected_ideas.idea: Combine all chains into one profitability result.
rejected_ideas.reason: Solana and EVM have different fee, inclusion, account, liquidity, and failure economics; each materially traded chain requires separate evidence before portfolio aggregation.

rejected_ideas.idea: Force trades to increase the sample size.
rejected_ideas.reason: A missing sample is preferable to capital exposure without positive conservative executable edge.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. The repository generally fails closed on absent executable edge and contains useful chain-specific protections, but the shared SHADOW framework records quote-derived estimates rather than forward realised outcomes and cannot establish durable money-weighted NET P&L. Solana SHADOW features deliberately lack current executable edge, while EVM simulated opportunities are not reconciled to later execution outcomes. Losses therefore cannot yet be reliably separated into STRATEGY/MARKET versus EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE categories. No profitability, CANARY-readiness, or LIVE-readiness claim is supported.
